frequency.en: Once per type of aid, every 3 months

summary.tl: Tulong ng DSWD para sa pamilyang may krisis: gastos sa ospital, gamot, libing, pag-aaral, pamasahe pauwi, o pagkain. Inuuna ang mahihirap at nangangailangan.
summary.en: DSWD help for families in crisis: hospital, medicine, burial, school, fare home, or food. Indigent and vulnerable families come first.

who.en: Individuals or families in crisis, as assessed by a social worker.

requirements.en: Barangay certificate or Certificate of Indigency

requirements.en: For medical: medical certificate or clinical abstract (within 3 months) and the bill, prescription or lab request

requirements.en: For burial: funeral contract and death certificate

requirements.tl: Para sa pag-aaral: certificate of enrollment o assessment at school ID
requirements.en: For school: certificate of enrollment or assessment and school ID

title.tl: 4Ps: buwanang cash grant para sa pamilya
title.en: 4Ps: monthly cash grant for families

amount_note.tl: kada buwan para sa kalusugan, dagdag ₱300–₱700 kada anak na nag-aaral (hanggang 3)
amount_note.en: a month for health, plus ₱300–₱700 per child in school (up to 3)

frequency.tl: Buwan-buwan, basta natutupad ang mga kondisyon
frequency.en: Monthly, as long as the conditions are met

summary.tl: Ang 4Ps ay cash grant para sa mahihirap na pamilyang may buntis o anak na 0–18. Kailangang magpa-check-up, pumasok sa paaralan ang mga bata, at dumalo sa Family Development Sessions.
summary.en: 4Ps is a cash grant for poor families with a pregnant member or children 0–18. Members get check-ups, keep children in school, and attend Family Development Sessions.

who.tl: Mahirap na pamilyang nasa listahan ng DSWD, may buntis o anak na 0–18.
who.en: Poor families on the DSWD list with a pregnant member or a child 0–18.

requirements.tl: Kailangang matukoy ng DSWD bilang mahirap na pamilya (household assessment)
requirements.en: The household must be identified as poor by DSWD (household assessment)

steps.tl: Magtanong sa 4Ps City Link o social welfare office ng lungsod kung paano ma-assess ang pamilya.
steps.en: Ask the city's 4Ps City Link or social welfare office how your household can be assessed.

steps.tl: Kapag napili, dumalo sa orientation at sundin ang mga kondisyon.
steps.en: If selected, attend the orientation and follow the conditions.

who.en: Families in 4Ps.

requirements.en: If not automatic: the lifeline rate application form

title.tl: UPLIFT: ₱2,000 kada buwan (Hulyo–Disyembre 2026)
title.en: UPLIFT: ₱2,000 a month (July–December 2026)

summary.tl: Pansamantalang tulong ng DSWD dahil sa taas-presyo ng gasolina at pagkain. Para sa mahihirap at halos-mahirap na pamilyang nasa CBMS ng PSA pero hindi kasama sa 4Ps, at para sa low-income na SSS member. Ang 4Ps families ay may isang beses na ₱2,000.
summary.en: Temporary DSWD aid for higher fuel and food prices. For poor and near-poor households in the PSA's CBMS who are not in 4Ps, and for low-income SSS members. 4Ps families get a one-time ₱2,000.

who.tl: Napili ng DSWD mula sa CBMS, 4Ps at SSS records. Hindi puwedeng mag-apply.
who.en: Selected by DSWD from CBMS, 4Ps and SSS records. You cannot apply.

requirements.tl: GCash o Landbank account (para sa payout)
requirements.en: GCash or Landbank account (for payouts)

steps.tl: Abangan ang abiso mula sa DSWD o sa barangay kung kasama kayo.
steps.en: Watch for a notice from DSWD or your barangay if you're included.

steps.tl: Mag-ingat sa scam: walang bayad at walang nag-a-apply sa pamamagitan ng link o text.
steps.en: Beware of scams: there's no fee, and no one applies through a link or text.
